name: ASM-003 hinge latch assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a compact hinge/latch mechanism with repeated knuckles and mounting bosses.

tasks.prompt: Create a compact hinge/latch mechanism assembly with two hinge leaves, repeated hinge knuckles, a continuous hinge pin, latch catch, and mounting bosses. Keep geometry robust and fast with boxes, cylinders, and compounds.
assumptions: Intermediate assembly benchmark intended to exercise hierarchy, named modules, and repeated functional components without BRIEF-001 full-vehicle complexity.
Robust simple boxes, cylinders, and compounds are preferred over fragile booleans or detailed decorative hardware.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
